audience: content teams and developers who read blueprints, documents and media assets in one Caisy project

useCases.title: Find entries with a read-only query
useCases.text: List the project's read queries to get the blueprint ids. Run a read-only query with filters, sorting and nested fields to find the entries.

useCases.title: Count documents in each blueprint
useCases.text: List the blueprint queries, then page through the document ids of each one. Unique blueprints have one entry, so read them with a query instead.

useCases.title: Read localized fields for one entry
useCases.text: Run a read-only query for one entry with the fields you need. Localized values come back in the same call.

useCases.title: List media assets with their URLs
useCases.text: List media assets with their title and source URL, page by page. Use the end cursor to read the next page of assets.
